author: Rileycat24
title: Frustrating but fun
content:
I actually love this game but there are some opportunities to make it better. Once you get to the higher levels they get ridiculously hard, there should be more boosters. Some games do a reward path, some games like this when other boosters that clear a particularly challenging bobbin, heck just something bc a game is supposed to be challenging not impossible once you hit level 1400. Isn’t the goal to keep me playing and spending money? Seems like you forgot that making it too hard to play means losing a player and having to spend money to attract a new one. Basic marketing strategy. Think it though. 

I will say the gameplay is super smooth. I wish they’d make similar colored bobbins have a colored border on the circle part or something so you can tell them apart bc sometimes you have 4 shades of a color and dark purple and dark blue look the same when you’re trying to play. This game could easily go from good to great.

Also why can’t we choose to skip the lucky shot level? It’s so annoying to finally get a super bobbin and immediately it’s a lucky shot level and you almost always lose it. 

I wouldn’t discourage anyone from playing but just be advised, that unless they do some updates, it’s going to get more frustrating than fun.

author: Slippery Hamster
title: Does anyone even read these?
content:
I’m not going to lie, I downloaded this game to make a little extra cash on the side (single mom life). 

The game is slow to start, but this is only to help you gain a false sense of security and confidence as you blow through levels.  That is, until you hit hard and then freakishly hard levels; leaving that once gained confidence hanging on by a thread. 

After playing for a little bit, I find myself yearning for the sweet balls of yarn and the joyful “swhhee swhhee clink” sound it makes when I unravel the canvases and unleash my bobbins of fury.  

This is definitely a game about strategy, timing, patience and the ability to develop a lazy eye to simultaneously look at the canvas quickly to determine what color of yarn to use next. One wrong move, one slightly off timed tap and you’re done. It’s a rush, the animations are cute and I apparently have developed an incisive need to prove I can outsmart these bobbins of chaos.

title: Not F2P friendly
content: Starting out in the beginning of the game is easy however once you start reaching lvl 60 and above it becomes so extremely difficult to pass the levels. Since you might start relying on power up’s in order to get an advantage in the levels you’ll need to start spending coins which is something you can’t get easily since you only get 40 or 80 per level if you watch ads.  If you don’t watch ads until level 60 you’ll only get 2,400 coins and of course with ads you’ll get 4,800 coins which might not be enough since in order to start where you left off if you fail a level you’ll need to spend 900 coins and power up’s cost 300-600 coins to use. On top of all that you don’t even get enough coins from the mini events and quests. This system promotes people to spend money just to have a chance at passing a level because the power up’s only HELP so if you mess up accidentally and fail you’ll need to spend 900 coins for a revive. This system is so terrible and encourages you to spend a lot of money. As much as this game tries to look “friendly” and “cute” it’s everything but. I really don’t recommend this game unless you are playing to earn for a reward app or if you just want to have a very difficult challenge.
